en-US.storage.app.name: Storage Manager
en-US.storage.title: Storage Manager
en-US.storage.intro.shares: Shared folders and their total quota.
en-US.storage.intro.homes: Each account’s private storage and personal quota.
en-US.storage.intro.volumes: Where data lives: ZFS, Btrfs or a plain directory.
en-US.storage.softQuotaHint: Quota is enforced for writes through MinhAnOS Files; direct writes on the server are not counted.
en-US.storage.shares.name: Display name
en-US.storage.shares.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; cannot be changed later.
en-US.storage.quota.limitHint: Leave empty for no limit. Lowering below current usage deletes nothing but blocks new writes.
en-US.storage.homes.measureQueued: Usage is re-measured the next time this user opens Files.
en-US.storage.homes.notMeasured: Not measured yet (measured when Files opens)
en-US.storage.settings.defaultHint: Applies to homes created after saving; existing users keep their quota.
en-US.storage.errors.quota: The limit must be a non-negative number of GB.
en-US.storage.errors.agentOffline: The storage agent is unreachable; showing saved data only.
en-US.storage.errors.STORAGE_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The storage agent is not configured on the server.
en-US.storage.errors.STORAGE_AGENT_ERROR: The storage agent refused the operation.
en-US.storage.errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Data changed; refresh and try again.
